description.zh:
是否移除资源上的所有标签。取值：
- **true**：表示是。
- **false**（默认）：表示否。
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resource. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false** (default)

description.zh: DoS高防实例所属地域ID。取值固定为**cn-hangzhou**，表示中国内地，即DDoS高防（中国内地）服务。
description.en: The region ID of the Anti-DDoS instance. The value is fixed to **cn-hangzhou**, which indicates the Chinese mainland.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh: 要移除标签的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。
description.en: A list of IDs of the Anti-DDoS instances from which you want to remove tags.

description.zh: 资源类型。取值固定为**INSTANCE**，表示DDoS高防实例。
description.en: The resource type. The value is fixed to **INSTANCE**, which indicates an Anti-DDoS instance.
A list of tag keys to remove.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于为DDoS高防（中国内地）实例移除标签。

> 只有DDoS高防（中国内地）服务支持标签功能。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This API operation removes tags from an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance.

> Only Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) supports the tag feature.

### QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --resource-type INSTANCE --all false --resource-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --tag-key doc-test-key --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo DeleteTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm2pz25js0000' --ResourceIds.1 'ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000' --TagKey.1 'doc-test-key' --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
